Class GameMesh

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Rendering
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents a 3D/2D mesh in the game's renderer. You can render it later on.

public class GameMesh : MightOwnMemoryAddressContainer, IDisposable

ColorData

The mesh's color vertices as bytes. Check HasColors or check if size is above 0 to know if this field is used. When uploading to an aura vertex buffer, make sure to set ElementSizeInBytes to 4 (uint or NUByte4).

NormalData

The mesh's normal vertices as bytes. Check HasNormals or check if size is above 0 to know if this field is used. When uploading to an aura vertex buffer, make sure to set ElementSizeInBytes to 16 (Vec4 or Float4).

The mesh's position vertices as bytes. Check HasPositions or check if size is above 0 to know if this field is used. When uploading to an aura vertex buffer, make sure to set ElementSizeInBytes to 12 (Vec3 or Float3).
